name: Step Lateral Step-Down

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: Cornell Health Lower Extremity Strengthening Protocol

steps: Stand tall on top of a low step or box (about 4 to 6 inches high) with your target leg bearing your weight on the edge.
Let your non-target leg hover freely off the side of the step.
Hinge your hips slightly back and bend your standing knee, slowly lowering your body until your hovering heel lightly taps the floor.
Keep your standing knee tracking straight over your second toe without caving inward.
Push through your standing heel to return to the starting position.
coaching_cues: Do not put weight onto the foot tapping the floor; merely graze it like touching thin ice.
Keep your hips square and do not let your pelvis tilt or drop.
Lower slowly over a 3-second count to load the quadriceps eccentrically.

sources.attribution: Cornell Health Lower Extremity Strengthening Protocol
